originalDsl:
@diagram uml-sequence
Viewer actor as "Viewer"
Player participant as "Client Player"
ManifestService participant as "Manifest Service"
LicenseServer participant as "License Server"
CDNEdge participant as "CDN Edge Node"
OriginServer participant as "Origin Server"
Analytics participant as "Analytics Service"

msg_1 = Viewer -#> Player as "press play"
msg_2 = Player -#> ManifestService as "request manifest"
msg_3 = ManifestService -.-> Player as "manifest (available renditions)"
msg_4 = Player -#> LicenseServer as "request DRM license"
msg_5 = LicenseServer -.-> Player as "license granted"
msg_6 = Player -#> CDNEdge as "request video segment"
msg_7 = CDNEdge -#> OriginServer as "fetch segment (cache miss)"
msg_8 = OriginServer -.-> CDNEdge as "segment data"
msg_9 = CDNEdge -.-> Player as "segment data"
msg_10 = Player -#> Analytics as "report playback started"
msg_11 = Player -#> CDNEdge as "request next segment"
msg_12 = CDNEdge -.-> Player as "segment data (cache hit)"
msg_13 = Player -#> Analytics as "report buffering event"
msg_14 = Player -.-> Viewer as "render video frame"
msg_15 = Player -#> Analytics as "report playback progress"

injectedDefects.description: inserted a line break inside label "CDN Edge Node"
